title: AI & Data Engineer
description:
AI & Data Engineer Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time
 About Us Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year ( Risk.net ). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.
 We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.
 The Role We're looking for a polyglot engineer who is comfortable across the data stack. This is someone who can build AI-powered tools and data infrastructure that make our platform smarter, our people more effective, and our operations more scalable.
 This is not a research role. You'll build real systems that people use every day — Slack bots that investigate production incidents, data pipelines that surface anomalies before clients notice them, and AI agents that turn hours of manual trawling into seconds of guided investigation. You'll work across the full stack: Python and TypeScript for AI tooling and integrations, Go for backend services, and SQL for data analysis and pipeline work.
 The person we're looking for ships working software, cares about making people's lives easier, and is energised by the pace of the AI landscape. You don't need to have built LLM applications before — but you should be curious, practical, and comfortable learning fast.
 You'll work closely with our TechOps, Connectivity, and Data teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and knowledge gaps — then build the tools and infrastructure that solve them. This is a high-leverage role: the systems you build will multiply the effectiveness of every engineer and operator in the company.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Who we are
 About Privy
 Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. We build simple, flexible developer tooling that make it easy to build products that put users first. By leveraging modern cryptography, we shift the status quo around digital ownership and protect the accounts and assets of millions of users.
 Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone
 About the Team
 Data at Privy is not just about running queries or building reports. We transform messy, high-volume data into scalable systems and clear insights that guide product decisions and business strategy. We design pipelines that are resilient, models that are intuitive, and tools that make data accessible and trustworthy for everyone across the company. We believe in clean abstractions, transparency, and sharing our work so teammates can build on top of it. We push each other to ask sharper questions, test bold ideas, and follow the signal in the data so we can shape better products and empower our customers.
 What you’ll do
 In this role you’ll partner deeply with product, engineering, and GTM teams across Privy to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You’ll work daily with partners across the Privy business to extract insights and build pipelines from the rich and complex Privy data set which is a unique combination of SaaS and blockchain data. You’ll build data products, metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards and reports to inform and run the business. You’ll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling while also providing data infrastructure that allows users and stakeholders to self serve their own analyses.

title: AI & Data Platform Engineer (GCP) (all levels)
description:
Über KnowWay KnowWay entwickelt KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur: Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Wir automatisieren Geschäftsprozesse mit autonomen Agenten, und zwar für Kunden, bei denen Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität Pflicht sind.
 Wir begleiten unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus. Wir sammeln und speichern die Daten, verarbeiten sie mit und für KI, sichern ihre Qualität und integrieren die Ergebnisse in produktive Systeme.
 Das Projekt Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Wir kennen die gesamte Prozess- und Systemlandschaft des Kunden, arbeiten darin und bauen mehrere Plattformen, auf denen die Fachbereiche ihre Anwendungsfälle betreiben. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel und stehen an unterschiedlichen Punkten zwischen Discovery und Live-Betrieb.
 Unser Delivery-Team deckt dabei ungewöhnlich viel ab: Business-Analyse und die Definition der eigentlichen Anforderungen, Solution Design, schnelle PoCs und die Produktivsetzung. Wo es passt, verwenden wir vorhandene Plattform-Capabilities wieder, und wo etwas fehlt, entwickeln wir es neu.
 Der Stack läuft bereits produktiv. Dazu gehören LLM-Extraktionspipelines über einen gemanagten AI-Service mit vorgeschaltetem Compliance-Proxy, agentische Systeme mit Vector Search, Batch-Verarbeitung und Orchestrierung, ein zentrales Data Warehouse und containerisierte Services. Die Infrastruktur ist komplett als Code beschrieben und läuft in einer streng abgeschotteten Umgebung mit mehreren Freigabestufen. Auf der Roadmap stehen unter anderem der Umbau des Query-Layers, die Anbindung von On-Premise-Systemen an Cloud-Worker und die Integration weiterer Quellsysteme.
 Die Rolle Du arbeitest mit uns dort, wo Datenpipelines, KI-Modelle und Cloud-Infrastruktur zusammenkommen. Gemeinsam mit dem Team sorgst Du dafür, dass das Ergebnis im Produktivbetrieb zuverlässig läuft, und…

title: Mainframe Data Engineer - 3 to 6 Months Contract
description:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Nebius :
 Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
 Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
 Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
 The role
 The Data Engineering team builds and operates the data platform that powers analytics, business intelligence, operational reporting, and data-driven products across Nebius. We ingest data from internal and external systems, develop reliable transformation pipelines and data models, and make trusted datasets available to business and product teams.
 We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own substantial parts of our data platform and deliver complex data products end to end. You will turn ambiguous business needs into pragmatic technical solutions, make architecture and implementation trade-offs, and improve the reliability, scalability, and usability of our data ecosystem.
 You will work closely with product, platform, and business teams, helping them use data effectively while ensuring that our systems remain maintainable and trustworthy as Nebius grows.
 Your responsibilities:

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Walker Sands is one of the fastest-growing integrated B2B marketing agencies in the world. We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to help fuel that continued growth. The starting salary for this role is expected to be between $155,000 and $175,000 per year.
 Walker Sands is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to join our DATA practice (Data, Analytics, Technology and AI) and help lead the data infrastructure behind our client reporting, measurement, internal operations, and AI-driven work.
 This is a hands-on role, but not a heads-down one. Reporting to the SVP, DATA, you'll lead key technical parts of our data stack and be a strategic partner on where it goes next: what to build, what to buy, what to fix, and what actually matters to the business. You don't need a lot of direction and are comfortable working through ambiguity.
 The role grows as you do. Near term, you'll work alongside our team and external partners to extend and strengthen the platform. Over time, you'll take on more of the technical ownership and help lead what comes next. And as the practice scales, you'll build and lead a small data support team handling tier 1 and tier 2 triage.
 What You Will Do (Responsibilities):
 Data Engineering
 Build and maintain pipelines and dbt models in Snowflake that are tested, documented, and trusted
 Integrate data from paid media, web analytics, SEO, CRM, and business systems using tools like Fivetran or Airbyte and direct APIs
 Find and fix breaks at the root, before an account team or client finds them
 Maintain data governance: access controls, privacy, and consent requirements
 Structure and document data so AI agents can use it reliable: clear semantic layers, consistent definitions, and metadata that tells an agent what a table or metric actually means
 Build governed access patterns for agentic tools (scoped, read-only, permission aware) so agents only query the data they're allowed to, and their answers can be traced back to the source

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
The Challenge
 Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for an Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team.
 You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics, and we will shape that together.
 Our current tech includes:
 Data warehouse: BigQuery
 Ingestion: Stitch
 Transformation: dbt Cloud
 Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight
What you’ll do
 Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion.
 Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page.
 Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust.
 Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making.
 Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business.
 AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer.

title: Senior Data Engineer, Cloudforce One
description:
About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
 Available Locations: London, UK
 About the role
 Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs).
